instruction: My roommates and I went for a dinner yesterday. I paid for the taxi back and forth (total $73) and Nancy paid for everyone's food (total $122). Both food and commute are supposed to be shared equally among all. Make necessary payment requests with a note "Taxi Fare", and a payment to Nancy with a note "Dinner Bill", on venmo.
notes: Roommates are discovered with a single phone.search_contacts(relationship="roommate") call, modeled by the knowledge predicate (roommates-found); the person->email association is a static structural fact and is only usable once that lookup has happened. The reference solution length (8 APIs) implies two roommates (Nancy plus one other), so the problem declares nancy and roommate-2; each roommate (including Nancy) gets a payment request for the taxi share (73/3) with note "Taxi Fare", and Nancy receives a transaction for the food share (122/3) with note "Dinner Bill". Amounts are runtime-computed objects named by role since their value depends on the roommate count. supervisor-complete-task takes the two roommate records (non-API parameters) so its precondition can express the full goal without domain constants for people; it is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every action. No payment card is passed to create_transaction (venmo balance assumed sufficient, as in the reference solution).
